'Instant - Banish this and a card from your hero's soul: Prevent the next 2 damage that would be dealt to your hero this turn.'

BANISH IS NOT DESTROY, and there was no banish-this cost until this card needed one. A destroyed card goes to the GRAVEYARD and a banished one does not, so writing DESTROY_SELF here would put the equipment in the wrong zone for every graveyard-recursion card, for Blade Break and Temper, and for anything counting a graveyard -- quietly, because the ability still resolves. Ten cards in the corpus pay this cost.

BOTH halves are costs, not effects: 'banish this AND a card from your soul' must both be payable before the shield exists, and a soul with no cards must not be able to activate it.
